title: The Long-Awaited Reunion
content:
Siddu took a deep breath before continuing.

"Satish sir dragged me straight to the principal's office."

"As soon as we entered, he explained everything that had happened in the classroom. He told the principal that I had argued with him, shouted in front of everyone, and disrespected him."

"The principal listened quietly without interrupting."

"When Satish sir finished, the principal looked at me."

"Now tell me your side of the story."

Siddu smiled faintly.

"I knew that if I told him the real reason, I would never be allowed to leave."

"So... I lied."

Sneha looked at him in surprise.

"You lied?"

Siddu nodded.

"I told the principal, 'Sir, I was writing notes during the class. After finishing them, I rested my head on the desk because I felt tired. When I woke up, the break had already ended. I suddenly realized I needed to rush to the washroom because it was an emergency.'"

"I continued, 'I politely requested permission from Satish sir, but before I could explain properly, he pushed me back toward my seat. I lost my temper because of the situation and raised my voice.'"

For a moment, the principal stared at me.

Then...

A smile slowly spread across the principal's face before he let out a soft laugh.

Sneha couldn't help smiling as well.

"He simply waved his hand and said,"

"Alright... go now. And next time, don't create such a scene."

"I thanked him and walked out as quickly as I could."

A mischievous smile appeared on Siddu's face.

"For a brief moment, I couldn't help smiling. Somehow, I had managed to fool Satish sir."

"But I didn't have time to celebrate."

"My only goal was to see Shreya."

"I ran toward her classroom."

"Unfortunately..."

"By the time I reached, the next lecture had already begun."

"The classroom door was closed."

"I stood outside for a few seconds, hoping she might look outside."

"But she never did."

With no other choice, I returned to my own classroom.

The next two lectures felt endless.

The teachers continued explaining lessons, writing on the board, and asking questions...

But I wasn't listening to a single word.

My mind had already left the classroom.

It wandered through every memory I had shared with Shreya.

The evenings we spent walking through the park...

The day we confessed our feelings...

The promises we had made...

And then...

Kiran's words echoed inside my mind once again.

"She's betraying you."

I immediately pushed the thought away.

"No," I told myself.

"I have to hear the truth from Shreya herself."

Finally...

The last bell rang.

Without waiting for anyone, I rushed toward her classroom.

Students were leaving in groups, chatting and laughing as they walked out.

Within a few moments, the room was almost empty.

Then...

I saw her.

She was sitting quietly at her desk near the window.

Months had changed her.

Her face looked pale and tired, as though she hadn't smiled in a long time.

Yet, to me...

she was still the most beautiful person in the room.

My heart began to race.

Slowly, I walked toward her.

Every step felt heavier than the last.

When I finally stood in front of her, I softly called,

"Shreya..."

She slowly lifted her head.

The moment our eyes met...

Shock filled her face.

For a few seconds, she simply stared at me, unable to believe I was standing there.

Her eyes began to glisten.

She instinctively took a step toward me, as though she wanted to hug me after months apart.

But just before she could...

Her eyes shifted toward the CCTV camera fixed in the corner of the classroom.

She stopped.

The distance between us remained unchanged.

Neither of us spoke.

We didn't need to.

After three long months...

Our eyes had already spoken the words our hearts had been waiting to say.
